mapper.update:
UPDATE SYS_USER
USER_NAME = #{userName},
USER_TYPE = #{userType},
EMAIL = #{email},
PHONE = #{phone},
STATUS = #{status},
EMPLOYEE_ID = #{employeeId},
DESCRIPTION = #{description},
address = #{address},
START_ACTIVE_DATE = #{startActiveDate}, END_ACTIVE_DATE = #{endActiveDate}, OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER = OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER+1, LAST_UPDATED_BY = #{request.userId}, LAST_UPDATE_DATE = current_timestamp
WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
UPDATE SYS_USER SET PASSWORD_ENCRYPTED = #{password,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, LAST_PASSWORD_UPDATE_DATE = current_timestamp WHERE USER_ID = #{userId,jdbcType=DECIMAL}

NAME AS EMPLOYEE_NAME FROM SYS_USER SU LEFT OUTER JOIN sys_user_allocation SUA ON SU.USER_ID = SUA.USER_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN SYS_ROLE_B SR ON SR.ROLE_ID = SUA.ROLE_ID AND SR.ENABLE_FLAG = 'Y' LEFT OUTER JOIN fnd_employee_assigns HEA ON SUA.EMPLOYEE_ASSIGN_ID = HEA.EMPLOYEE_ASSIGN_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN fnd_employee HE ON HEA.EMPLOYEE_ID = HE.EMPLOYEE_ID WHERE upper(SU.ATTRIBUTE3) = upper(#{attribute3,jdbcType=VARCHAR})

NAME AS EMPLOYEE_NAME FROM SYS_USER SU LEFT OUTER JOIN sys_user_allocation SUA ON SU.USER_ID = SUA.USER_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN SYS_ROLE_B SR ON SR.ROLE_ID = SUA.ROLE_ID AND SR.ENABLE_FLAG = 'Y' LEFT OUTER JOIN fnd_employee_assigns HEA ON SUA.EMPLOYEE_ASSIGN_ID = HEA.EMPLOYEE_ASSIGN_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN fnd_employee HE ON HEA.EMPLOYEE_ID = HE.EMPLOYEE_ID WHERE upper(SU.USER_NAME) = upper(#{userName,jdbcType=VARCHAR})

fou.UNIT_ID = ( SELECT fopb.unit_id FROM FND_ORG_POSITION fopb WHERE fopb.POSITION_ID = ( SELECT feab.POSITION_ID FROM fnd_employee_assigns feab WHERE feab.employee_assign_id IN ( SELECT employee_assign_id FROM sys_user_allocation WHERE user_id = (select su1.user_id from sys_user su1 where su1.user_name = #{userName})) AND PRIMARY_POSITION_FLAG = 'Y' ) ) )

SELECT (select su.USER_NAME from sys_user su where su.USER_ID = sua.user_id) user_name FROM sys_user_allocation sua WHERE sua.EMPLOYEE_ASSIGN_ID IN ( SELECT DISTINCT EMPLOYEE_ASSIGN_ID FROM fnd_employee_assigns WHERE POSITION_ID = ( SELECT POSITION_ID FROM FND_ORG_POSITION WHERE POSITION_CODE = #{positionCode} AND ENABLED_FLAG ='Y' ) AND company_id = #{companyId} AND ENABLED_FLAG ='Y' )
SELECT DISTINCT U.USER_ID FROM sys_user U LEFT JOIN SYS_USER_ALLOCATION UR ON UR.USER_ID = U.USER_ID LEFT JOIN SYS_ROLE_B R ON R.ROLE_ID = UR.ROLE_ID WHERE R.ROLE_CODE = #{roleCode}

SELECT (SELECT USER_NAME FROM SYS_USER WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}) AS NAME, (SELECT POSITION_NAME FROM FND_ORG_POSITION FOP WHERE FOP.POSITION_ID = FEA.POSITION_ID) AS POSITION_NAME, (SELECT UNIT_NAME FROM FND_ORG_UNIT FOU WHERE FOU.UNIT_ID = FEA.UNIT_ID) AS UNITNAME, FEA.UNIT_ID unitId FROM FND_EMPLOYEE_ASSIGNS FEA WHERE EMPLOYEE_ASSIGN_ID = ( SELECT EMPLOYEE_ASSIGN_ID FROM SYS_USER_ALLOCATION SUA WHERE SUA.USER_ID = #{userId} AND SUA.ENABLED_FLAG = 'Y' ) AND FEA.ENABLED_FLAG = 'Y' AND PRIMARY_POSITION_FLAG = 'Y'

select * from SYS_USER SU
AND SU.DESCRIPTION LIKE concat('%', concat(#{description}, '%'))
AND SU.USER_NAME LIKE concat('%', concat(#{userName}, '%'))
select max(su.user_id) userId from sys_user su where su.user_name = #{userName}

SELECT max(sua.user_id) userId FROM sys_user_allocation sua WHERE sua.employee_assign_id = ( SELECT max(fea.employee_assign_id) FROM fnd_employee_assigns fea WHERE fea.enabled_flag = 'Y' AND fea.employee_id = ( SELECT fe.employee_id FROM fnd_employee fe WHERE fe.employee_code = #{code} ) )
SELECT * FROM sys_user u WHERE u.USER_ID = #{userId,jdbcType=BIGINT}

SELECT sua.USER_ID, fe.EMPLOYEE_CODE, fe.name EMPLOYEE_NAME FROM fnd_employee fe INNER JOIN fnd_employee_assigns fea ON fe.employee_id = fea.employee_id INNER JOIN sys_user_allocation sua ON sua.employee_assign_id = fea.employee_assign_id where fea.position_id = #{positionId}

select su.description, fou.unit_name unit_id_n,su.user_id,sua.allocation_id from sys_user_allocation sua, fnd_employee_assigns fea, fnd_org_unit fou, sys_user su
su.user_id = sua.user_id and sua.employee_assign_id = fea.employee_assign_id and fou.unit_id = fea.unit_id and fea.primary_position_flag = 'Y' and fea.enabled_flag = 'Y' and sua.enabled_flag = 'Y'
and su.user_id != #{userId}
and fou.unit_id in (select ass.unit_id from sys_user_allocation alla,fnd_employee_assigns ass where alla.employee_assign_id = ass.employee_assign_id and alla.user_id = #{userId} and alla.enabled_flag = 'Y' and ass.enabled_flag = 'Y')
and fou.unit_code in ('DEPT0102','DEPT0103','DEPT0104','DEPT0204','DEPT0205','DEPT0206', 'DEPT0207','DEPT0208','DEPT0209','DEPT0225','DEPT0402','DEPT0403')
and su.description like concat('%', concat(#{description,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%'))

SELECT su.user_id, su.user_name, su.bp_id, hbm.bp_name bp_name, CASE WHEN ( SELECT COUNT( 1 ) FROM HLS_BP_MASTER_ROLE hbmr WHERE su.bp_id = hbmr.bp_id AND hbmr.BP_CATEGORY = 'DEALER' ) > 0 THEN 'DEALER' ELSE ( SELECT hbmr.bp_category FROM HLS_BP_MASTER_ROLE hbmr inner join hls_bp_category hbc ON hbc.bp_category = hbmr.bp_type WHERE su.bp_id = hbmr.bp_id and hbc.description = su.bp_category ) END AS bp_category FROM SYS_USER SU LEFT JOIN hls_bp_master hbm on su.bp_id = hbm.bp_id
AND SU.USER_ID=#{userId}

select su.USER_ID, su.USER_TYPE, su.USER_NAME, su.PASSWORD_ENCRYPTED, su.EMAIL, su.PHONE, su.START_ACTIVE_DATE, su.END_ACTIVE_DATE, su.STATUS, su.FIRST_LOGIN, su.DESCRIPTION, su.EMPLOYEE_ID, su.CUSTOMER_ID, su.SUPPLIER_ID, su.BP_ID, su.BP_CATEGORY from SYS_USER su, (select sua.USER_ID from FND_EMPLOYEE_ASSIGNS fea, SYS_USER_ALLOCATION sua where fea.EMPLOYEE_ID = #{employeeId} and fea.EMPLOYEE_ASSIGN_ID = sua.EMPLOYEE_ASSIGN_ID group by sua.USER_ID) t1 where su.USER_ID = t1.USER_ID
